description: List French Assemblée nationale deputies with party, département, profession and contact details. Defaults to the 16th legislature (2022–2024, 618 deputies) — NosDéputés never ingested the 17th, so this is a historical record, not the currently sitting chamber.

departement.description: Département name (matched against `nom_circo`) or 2-3 char code (`num_deptmt`), e.g. "Paris" or "75".

group.description: Group acronym, matched against `groupe_sigle`. The 16th legislature uses REN (193), RN (90), LFI (76), LR (62), MODEM (58), HOR (34), SOC (31), GDR (24), LIOT, ECOLO, NI. Call list_groups for the full set.

name: list_deputies
